canonical_project: Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz new data center
owner: Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz / State of Rhineland-Palatinate
notes: NHR South-West/JGU announcement reports roofing ceremony after major structural work, EUR 29 million state-funded project, enterprise and HPC sections, 144 planned server racks, and maximum IT load of 3,600 kW; source expected full operation by mid-2025 but did not itself confirm commissioning.
